data.one_liner: An accessible, theme-aware Flutter calendar with lazy month and week paging.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable month and week calendar views with event markers, date selection, and navigation controls. Built on the material_ui package.
use_when: You need to display a month or week calendar view with event markers.
You require accessibility, theme-awareness, and customizable day and header builders.
avoid_when: Your application is still using the standard in-framework package:flutter/material.dart instead of material_ui (for version 4.0).
You need complex event scheduling and calendar management out of the box.
strengths: Lazy month and week paging for performance.
Typed event builders and application model integration.
Configurable layout, paging, and theming objects.
weaknesses: Requires migrating to the standalone material_ui package on version 4.0.
Strict dependency on Flutter >=3.47.0 and Dart ^3.13.0.
data.setup_notes: Add material_ui as a dependency and ensure your app hosts the calendar under a material_ui MaterialApp or Localizations ancestor.
